title: The form of a commit that declares a cut complete
situation: Record corrections, third cold read, 2026-10-13: the completion check watches commits 'in forms enumerated by decision', and the only list was in 0081, a decision about the reconstitution cut, now history (0161).
decision: The completion check watches one form: a conventional commit scoped to its cut, `feat(cut:<cut>): <message>`.
consequences: The completion check concept points here.
